summary: The note is a short encyclopedic entry on Rio Linda High School, a high school in Rio Linda, Sacramento, California. It reports the school's enrollment of 2,035 students. It notes the school is part of the Twin Rivers Unified School District and was formerly part of the Grant Unified School District.
one_line: Rio Linda High School is a 2,035-student high school in Rio Linda, Sacramento, California, in the Twin Rivers Unified School District.

Rio Linda High School is part of the Twin Rivers Unified School District.
Rio Linda High School was formerly part of the Grant Unified School District.
